  • AY2026-27 Term 1: e$10 and End-term Course Feedback (Undergraduate)

    Sample Staff posted on Nov 6, 2026 10:00 AM
    Edited

    <<This message applies only to students enrolled in AY2026-27 Term 1 undergraduate courses>>

    Dear Students,

    The Undergraduate End-term Course Feedback Exercise for AY2026-27 Term 1 has started. You will receive e$10 after you have successfully submitted the feedback for your listed courses. The e$ will be credited to your E-Account 1 week after end-of-term. (Note: e$ does not apply to exchange students)

    Course Feedback Period:
    You can submit your responses from Friday, 6 November (10.00am) to Sunday, 22 November (11.59pm) via  https://feedback.example.edu/student.

    If you encounter technical difficulties, please clear your browser cache and try again, or access the link using Firefox Private/Incognito mode.

    Some University-XO, Study Mission, and Work-Study Elective courses show a "pending" status as they have a different feedback period and you will be notified of the dates in due course. The crediting of e$ will not be affected by such courses.

    Purpose:
    Your input is important in helping your instructors identify their strengths and areas for improvement. The information will be provided to University administrators as an input for teaching evaluations, promotions, salary adjustments, contract renewal decisions for the instructor, and curriculum improvement.  The data may also be processed by approved AI tools to track the overall teaching effectiveness and trends at University.

    Anonymity:
    In the interest of preserving anonymity, you are reminded not to state your name anywhere on the survey, or provide any comments that could disclose your identity. While responses are treated confidentially, you are reminded to exercise this privilege responsibly in your feedback. Any writing amounting to harassment or threat on any person will be subjected to university inquiry.

    Release of Feedback Reports:
    The feedback report will only be released to instructors after students’ grades are officially released by the Registrar’s Office.

    For questions on e$, please contact the Registry Team at student@example.com. For questions about the Course Feedback Exercise, contact the Teaching Excellence Centre at student@example.com. Thank you for your participation.

    Best regards,
    Teaching Excellence Centre
